name: @pipeworx/mcp-podcastindex

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Podcast search by term. Find podcasts in the open podcast database by name or keyword. Returns matching podcasts with title, author, description, categories, episode count, and artwork. Example: search_podcasts({ query: "true crime", max: 10 })

query.description: Search term — podcast name or keyword, e.g. "true crime", "javascript"

max.description: Maximum number of podcasts to return (default 10, max 40)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Podcast Index credentials as KEY:SECRET for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: get_podcast
tools.description: Get full metadata for a single podcast by its Podcast Index feed ID. Returns title, author, description, owner, episode count, categories, language, and artwork. Example: get_podcast({ feed_id: 920666 })

feed_id.description: Podcast Index feed ID (from search_podcasts or trending podcasts results)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Podcast Index credentials as KEY:SECRET for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: episodes
tools.description: List recent episodes for a podcast by its Podcast Index feed ID. Returns episode title, description, publish date, duration, audio URL, and episode/season numbers. Example: episodes({ feed_id: 920666, max: 10 })

feed_id.description: Podcast Index feed ID (from search_podcasts or trending podcasts results)

max.description: Maximum number of episodes to return (default 10, max 100)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Podcast Index credentials as KEY:SECRET for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Get trending podcasts across the open podcast database, ranked by recent activity. Optionally filter by language or category. Returns podcast title, author, categories, artwork, and trend score. Example: trending({ max: 10, lang: "en", cat: "Technology" })

max.description: Maximum number of trending podcasts to return (default 10, max 40)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Podcast Index credentials as KEY:SECRET for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-podcastindex forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the podcastindex pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
